name: Florida

sources.label: Florida Statutes (2026) s. 1003.4282 — Requirements for a standard high school diploma
Florida Statutes (2026) s. 1002.3105 — ACCEL options (18-credit diploma)

plans.name: Standard Diploma (24 credits)

subjects.label: English Language Arts
subjects.notes: ELA I, II, III, and IV

subjects.label: Mathematics
subjects.notes: Must include Algebra I and Geometry

subjects.label: Science
subjects.notes: Must include Biology I; two of the three credits need a lab

subjects.label: Social Studies
subjects.notes: U.S. History, World History, half a credit of economics, and half a credit of U.S. Government

subjects.label: Fine or Performing Arts, Speech and Debate, or CTE
subjects.notes: Some practical arts courses also count

subjects.label: Physical Education
subjects.notes: Includes health; two seasons of a JV or varsity sport can count

plans.notes: Includes 7.5 elective credits. You also need at least a 2.0 cumulative GPA on a 4.0 scale.

plans.name: ACCEL 18-Credit Option

subjects.label: English Language Arts
subjects.notes: ELA I, II, III, and IV

subjects.label: Mathematics
subjects.notes: Must include Algebra I and Geometry

subjects.label: Science
subjects.notes: Must include Biology I; two of the three credits need a lab

subjects.label: Social Studies
subjects.notes: U.S. History, World History, half a credit of economics, and half a credit of U.S. Government

subjects.label: Fine or Performing Arts, Speech and Debate, or CTE

plans.notes: No physical education credit is required. Includes 2.5 elective credits. You also need at least a 2.0 cumulative GPA, and the same state tests as the 24-credit diploma.

plans.name: Career and Technical Education (CTE) Pathway

subjects.label: English Language Arts
subjects.notes: ELA I, II, III, and IV

subjects.label: Mathematics
subjects.notes: Must include Algebra I and Geometry

subjects.label: Science
subjects.notes: Must include Biology I; two of the three credits need a lab

subjects.label: Social Studies
subjects.notes: U.S. History, World History, half a credit of economics, and half a credit of U.S. Government

subjects.label: Career and Technical Education
subjects.notes: Courses must lead to a program completion and an industry certification

plans.notes: Includes 1.5 credits of electives or work-based learning. No arts or physical education credit is required. You also need at least a 2.0 cumulative GPA.

otherRequirements: Pass the statewide grade 10 English Language Arts test, or earn a concordant score
Pass the statewide Algebra I end-of-course exam, or earn a comparative score
End-of-course exams in Algebra I, Geometry, Biology I, and U.S. History count for 30% of the final grade in those courses
Take the state civic literacy test as part of the U.S. Government course
Earn at least a 2.0 cumulative GPA on a 4.0 scale
districtNote: These are Florida's state minimums, and your school district may require more. Districts must explain the diploma options in writing and include the 18-credit CTE pathway in their student progression plan.
